# Gaudiya Kirtan Color Scheme

This document defines the unified color scheme for the Gaudiya Kirtan application across all platforms.

## Primary Colors

| Name | Light Mode | Dark Mode | Description |
|------|------------|-----------|-------------|
| `primary` | `#1A1A1A` | `#E0E0E0` | Primary text and important content |
| `background` | `#FFF4E8` | `#191919` | Main background color |
| `backgroundOffset` | `#F6EDDF` | `#252525` | Secondary background for cards and UI elements |
| `highlight` | `#B36B00` | `#8CB4FF` | Accent color for important elements and links |
| `neutral` | `#6E6E6E` | `#9B9B9B` | Secondary text and less important content |

## Implementation Guide

### iOS (Swift)

Colors are defined in the Assets catalog and accessed using SwiftUI's Color extension:

```swift
// Color extension is automatically generated by asset catalog
Color.primary       // Primary text color
Color.background    // Main background color
Color.backgroundOffset // Secondary background color
Color.highlight     // Accent color
Color.neutral       // Secondary text color
```

### Android (Java/Kotlin)

For XML-based layouts:

```xml
<color name="primary_light">#1A1A1A</color>
<color name="primary_dark">#E0E0E0</color>
<color name="background_light">#FFF4E8</color>
<color name="background_dark">#191919</color>
<color name="background_offset_light">#F6EDDF</color>
<color name="background_offset_dark">#252525</color>
<color name="highlight_light">#B36B00</color>
<color name="highlight_dark">#8CB4FF</color>
<color name="neutral_light">#6E6E6E</color>
<color name="neutral_dark">#9B9B9B</color>
```

For Jetpack Compose:

```kotlin
val LightColorScheme = lightColorScheme(
    primary = Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
    onPrimary = Color.White,
    background = Color(0xFFFFF4E8),
    onBackground = Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
    surface = Color(0xFFF6EDDF),
    onSurface = Color(0xFF1A1A1A),
    secondary = Color(0xFFB36B00),
    onSecondary = Color.White,
    tertiary = Color(0xFF6E6E6E),
    onTertiary = Color.White
)

val DarkColorScheme = darkColorScheme(
    primary = Color(0xFFE0E0E0),
    onPrimary = Color.Black,
    background = Color(0xFF191919),
    onBackground = Color(0xFFE0E0E0),
    surface = Color(0xFF252525),
    onSurface = Color(0xFFE0E0E0),
    secondary = Color(0xFF8CB4FF),
    onSecondary = Color.Black,
    tertiary = Color(0xFF9B9B9B),
    onTertiary = Color.Black
)
```

### Web (CSS/TailwindCSS)

For TailwindCSS:

```js
// tailwind.config.js
module.exports = {
  theme: {
    extend: {
      colors: {
        gaur: {
          primary: '#1A1A1A',
          background: '#FFF4E8',
          'background-offset': '#F6EDDF',
          highlight: '#B36B00',
          neutral: '#6E6E6E',
        },
        shyam: {
          primary: '#E0E0E0',
          background: '#191919',
          'background-offset': '#252525',
          highlight: '#8CB4FF',
          neutral: '#9B9B9B',
        },
      },
    },
  },
}
```

Usage in CSS/components:

```css
/* Light mode (default) */
.text-primary { color: var(--gaur-primary, #1A1A1A); }
.bg-background { background-color: var(--gaur-background, #FFF4E8); }
.bg-offset { background-color: var(--gaur-background-offset, #F6EDDF); }
.text-highlight { color: var(--gaur-highlight, #B36B00); }
.text-neutral { color: var(--gaur-neutral, #6E6E6E); }

/* Dark mode */
.dark .text-primary { color: var(--shyam-primary, #E0E0E0); }
.dark .bg-background { background-color: var(--shyam-background, #191919); }
.dark .bg-offset { background-color: var(--shyam-background-offset, #252525); }
.dark .text-highlight { color: var(--shyam-highlight, #8CB4FF); }
.dark .text-neutral { color: var(--shyam-neutral, #9B9B9B); }
```
